Name: StardewValley Mod Manager(SMM)
Author: ralotte
Description:
SMM: Stardew Mod Manager

SMM is a lightweight and intuitive mod manager for Stardew Valley, designed to help players manage mod profiles, enable or disable mods, check warnings, and launch the game from one clean interface.

Version 2.0.0 introduces a redesigned UI, installer support, profile backup/export, language settings, theme settings, and a more polished workflow.

## Core Features

- Profile Management 
  Create, rename, switch, back up, and export mod profiles.

- Mod Toggle 
  Enable or disable mods with a single click.

- SMAPI & Game Status 
  Check whether SMAPI and Stardew Valley are detected correctly.

- Mod Validation 
  Detect mod warnings and errors based on manifest information.

- Search, Filter, and Sort 
  Quickly find mods by name and organize the list by status or enabled state.

- Game Launch 
  Start Stardew Valley/SMAPI directly from the manager.

- Language Settings 
  Supports English and Korean.

- Nexus & Ko-fi Links 
  Access the official SMM Nexus page and Ko-fi support page directly from the app.

## Installation

1. Download `SMM_Setup_v2.0.0.exe` from the Files tab.
2. Run the installer.
3. Launch Stardew Mod Manager from the Start Menu or desktop shortcut.
4. Make sure SMAPI is installed before using the manager.

No manual extraction is required.

## Notes

SMM manages your Stardew Valley Mods folder by using profiles. 
Before making major changes to your mod setup, using the Backup or Export feature is recommended.

## Reporting Issues

If you encounter bugs or have suggestions, please use the Posts or Bugs tab on this mod page.

When reporting errors, please include:

- What you were trying to do
- Your SMAPI log, if related to mod loading
- A screenshot, if the issue is UI-related
